title: Takopi's Original Sin Announces Movie
content: Takopi’s Original Sin has announced a movie titled, Takopi’s Original Sin -Thank You, See You Tomorrow- . The movie will compile all six episodes of the anime series and feature a re-edited version created specifically for theaters, including newly added scenes. A trailer was also released.
author: Anime Corner

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Wins Film of the Year Award at Crunchyroll's 2026 Anime Awards
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle won the Film of the Year award at Crunchyroll’s 2026 Anime Awards. title: Meiji Tokyo Renka: Twilight Kiss Visual Novel to Release in English on Switch, Steam in 2026
content: A new website for the Meiji Tokyo Renka : Twilight Kiss game announced on Friday that the sequel game to the Meiji Tokyo Renka Full Moon visual novel will release on Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam in 2026. The game will have options for English, Japanese, and Chinese subtitles with Japanese voice lines.
author: ANN

title: Exstetra RPG's HD Remaster Releases on Steam in English on July 30
content: FuRyu announced on Saturday that the HD remaster for its Exstetra fantasy role-playing game will launch on PC via Steam in English on July 30. The company streamed the opening movie for the game.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 Winners: Full Results List
content: The results for the Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 are being announced today, celebrating the biggest anime series, films, characters, performances, and creators of the year. Winners are selected through a combination of global fan voting and input from an international judging panel.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ayanokoji Fights Nanase in Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 12 Preview
content: Classroom of the Elite Season 4 revealed the Episode 2 preview, ahead of the episode’s May 27 premiere. The episode teases a fight between Kiyotaka Ayanokoji and Tsubasa Nanase, as well as showing numerous other characters who will be appearing.
author: Anime Corner

title: 14 Years Later, Naruto’s Final War Gets a New Official Release
content: Masashi Kishimoto’s beloved Weekly Shonen Jump series Naruto has one of the most unique power systems in Shonen. The series is still loved among global fans thanks to its captivating story, intriguing characters, and thrilling fights.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Action Series Unveils New Look At Beloved Characters Amid Season 3 Delay
content: Wind Breaker is one of the most acclaimed high school action series in recent years. The anime is based on the ongoing manga by Satoru Nii, which began serialization in Kodansha’s Magazine pocket . The anime originally debuted in 2024 and released a sequel a year later, both of which became major hits on Crunchyroll.

content: Ever since the year began, Netflix has been dropping one exciting anime series after another, including Love Through a Prism, Cosmic Princess Kaguya, Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai, and many more.
